policy_title: HCC High School Admission & Enrollment Regulations

key_policies.merit_and_interaction: For Pre-Primary and Primary (Grades 1-5), admission is granted after friendly informal interaction with parents and child. For Grades 6 to 10, a diagnostic competency assessment in English and Mathematics is conducted to ascertain foundational readiness.
key_policies.sibling_priority: Real brothers and sisters of currently enrolled HCC High School students are given priority consideration during seat allocation.
key_policies.rte_reservation: 25% of seats at the entry level (Nursery / Grade 1) are strictly reserved under the Right to Education (RTE) Act as governed by the Maharashtra State Education Department online portal.
key_policies.non_discrimination: HCC High School adheres to an equal opportunity policy. Admissions are granted without discrimination based on caste, religion, community, or economic background.
fee_refund_policy: The admission fee of ₹5,000 is one-time and non-refundable under any circumstances after admission confirmation.

If a written cancellation request is submitted before the start of the academic session (prior to June 1, 2026), tuition fee paid will be refunded after deducting a ₹1,000 administrative processing charge.
No tuition fee refunds will be processed after the commencement of the academic term.
key_policies.verification_mandate: Admission offers are provisional until all mandatory original documents (Birth Certificate, LC/TC, Marksheet, and Aadhaar) are submitted and verified by the school registrar.
